requested_outcome: Restore Ahuzat Yosef's verified video and prevent supplier videos from being dropped by accepted catalog generation.
natural_destination: The matching place gallery on VII business pages.
authorization_boundary: Local repair and verification only; no deployment in this turn.

lesson_bundle.reason: One recovered place does not prove the full supplier-video family or public destination.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Separate local family repair from public and full legacy-inventory verification.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Ahuzat Yosef remains missing although another place video works.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Bind the exact legacy video to vacation-279 and test the exact identity.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: vacation-279 resolves only to YouTube ID 7FAVmV3P8oI.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The next catalog rebuild drops API videos again.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use the shared safe supplier-video normalizer in the build-time mapper.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The build mapper explicitly persists normalized raw.videos or raw.video.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A video leaks to another business or an unsafe URL is embedded.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep place-scoped IDs and strict privacy-enhanced YouTube validation.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Cross-place and unsafe URL negative controls pass.

affected_family: vacation and event accepted detail generation

sources.label: Supplier videos require a verified upstream contract

midpoint_gate.trigger: After comparing legacy HTML, accepted detail data and actual gallery behavior.
checks: Distinguish data loss from render failure

attack_questions: Does the wrong place receive the video?
Can an unsafe embed URL render?
Does build-time generation still omit raw supplier videos?
Is the exact public page verified after deployment?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact public page after an authorized deployment.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused normalizer, registry, gallery and critical page-path tests.

effectiveness.baseline: 702 accepted static details contain zero videos and vacation-279 has no public video.
effectiveness.target: Preserve every safe upstream video during accepted generation and restore the verified Ahuzat Yosef example without cross-place leakage.
